passages.deduction: Reasoning from a general rule to a conclusion about a particular case is ded______.
passages.determinism: The philosopher defended det________, the view that events are fixed by prior causes and natural laws.
passages.fallacy: The argument contains a fal____: it attacks the speaker instead of addressing the claim.
passages.free-will: The debate concerns free wi__ and whether people can genuinely choose among alternatives.
passages.human-nature: The essay asks whether cooperation or competition is more fundamental to human nat___.
passages.idealism: The thinker defended ide_____, holding that mind or ideas are fundamental to reality.
passages.induction: Inferring a general pattern from many particular observations is ind______.
passages.metaphysics: Questions about existence, causation, and the nature of reality belong to met________.
passages.moral-relativism: The position called moral rel_______ holds that moral judgments depend on a cultural or other framework.
passages.objectivity: The investigator sought obj________ by judging the evidence independently of personal preferences.
passages.skepticism: Philosophical ske_______ questions whether a claimed source of knowledge can provide certainty.
passages.utilitarianism: Under uti___________, an action is judged by its consequences for overall well-being.

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete ded______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：uction → deduction。学習語：deduction。deductionは「演繹」。一般的な前提から個別の結論を導く推論です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete det________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：erminism → determinism。学習語：determinism。determinismは「決定論」。出来事が先行原因と法則によって定まるという立場です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete fal____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：lacy → fallacy。学習語：fallacy。fallacyは「論理的誤り」。主張への反論を人物攻撃で置き換える誤りです。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete wi__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ll → will。学習語：free will。free willは「自由意志」。人が選択肢の中から自ら選べるかという論点です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete nat___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ure → nature。学習語：human nature。human natureは「人間の本性」。人間に基本的な性質を問う文脈です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete ide_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：alism → idealism。学習語：idealism。idealismは哲学の「観念論」。実在の根本に精神・観念を置く立場です。日常語の理想主義とは区別します。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete ind______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：uction → induction。学習語：induction。inductionは「帰納」。個々の観察から一般的な傾向を推論します。演繹と異なり結論は必ずしも確実ではありません。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete met________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：aphysics → metaphysics。学習語：metaphysics。metaphysicsは「形而上学」。存在・原因・実在の根本的な性質を扱います。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete rel_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ativism → relativism。学習語：moral relativism。moral relativismは「道徳的相対主義」。道徳判断が文化などの枠組みに依存する立場です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete obj________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ectivity → objectivity。学習語：objectivity。objectivityは「客観性」。個人の好みから独立して証拠を判断することです。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete ske_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：pticism → skepticism。学習語：skepticism。skepticismは「懐疑主義」。知識の根拠や確実性を問い直す姿勢です。

questions.prompt: Philosophy: complete uti___________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：litarianism → utilitarianism。学習語：utilitarianism。utilitarianismは「功利主義」。行為の結果が全体の幸福・福祉に及ぼす影響を重視します。
